verdict.rationale: As a Python/JS library, the SDK is driven entirely from code. Runner.run(), Runner.run_sync() and Runner.run_streamed() let a script or pipeline invoke agents with no UI. Environment variables such as OPENAI_DEFAULT_MODEL and OPENAI_AGENTS_DISABLE_TRACING suit non-interactive configuration, and community reports describe running it inside durable Temporal workflows and in production. Missing for 10: explicit first-party CI/CD integration docs or examples (e.g. GitHub Actions), and independent hands-on reports of running it in CI pipelines.
